primary.title: Earning income from YouTube: Here's how Indian creators should calculate tax and file ITR
primary.summary: If you are an Indian content creator earning income from YouTube, it is important to understand how your dollar earnings should be converted, taxed and reported in your ITR. Knowing the correct rules can help you avoid errors and ensure proper tax compliance.
